root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states: "ksmbd does not verify if the user attempting to reconnect to a durable handle is the same user who originally opened the file. The fix also calls `ksmbd_vfs_copy_durable_owner()` when the handle becomes orphaned (in `session_fd_check`).

The persistent_id field uniquely identifies durable handles. Its predictability (if not properly randomized) allows an attacker to guess or enumerate IDs to hijack orphaned handles.
